liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Comes A Time** (3 reviews): Reviewer found the Comes a Time into The Other One segment cool, though the show overall was slow and trippy; Described as a very heartfelt version of Comes a Time [10][12][13]
- **Let It Grow** (2 reviews): Let It Grow blends into Althea beautifully, but the circulating recording cuts just as they merge; Let It Grow singled out as particularly strong playing [14][19]
- **Easy To Love You** (2 reviews): Reviewer enjoyed Easy To Love You; Joking that nobody knows who sings backup vocals on Easy to Love You because nobody listens to it [14][20]
- **Alabama Getaway** (1 review): The opening notes of Alabama Getaway struck the reviewer instantly at their first show [18]
- **Feel Like A Stranger** (1 review): Reviewer likes the Feel Like A Stranger versions from this decade generally [12]
- **Lost Sailor** (1 review): Lost Sailor into Saint of Circumstance singled out as particularly good playing [19]

## Setlist highlights

- **Don't Ease Me In *Audience Only**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [22]

## The recordings

- **gd1980-05-14.126608.mtx.dusborne.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 23 songs; 157 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [1]
- **gd80-05-14.sbd.clugston.3295.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 22 songs; 145 min; rated 3.77/5 by 13 [6]. Said about its sound: Soundboard sounds very good, with strong playing throughout [19]
- **gd1980-05-14.thru.05-16.fm.kbfh.34685.sbeok.flac16**: FM broadcast; 9 songs; 69 min; rated 3/5 by 3 [9]. Said about its sound: Reviewer of the FM broadcast copy found the sound poor and recommends the other soundboard or the audience recording instead [17]
- **gd1980-05-14.125962.naks.wise.minches.flac2496**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 23 songs; 153 min [2]

## Around the show

- Reviewer's first Dead show, attended in tenth grade; the opening notes of Alabama Getaway convinced them immediately [18]
- Reviewer attended the Friday show, which rocked more; says parts of this night appear on Go To Nassau [10]
- Attendee says none of this show was used on Go To Nassau; found it laid back but fun, with the third night far better [11]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1980-05-14.126608.mtx.dusborne.flac16**: transferred by Matrix by Dave Usborne; source: 2 source matrix by dusborne; Soundboard (shnid:3295) Master Soundboard Cassette > Reel to Reel > DAT > CDR; CD Mastering by Scott Clugston and Audience… [1]. Also: Matrix recording by dusborne; show information is embedded in the header of each FLAC file [1]
- **gd80-05-14.sbd.clugston.3295.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [6]
- **gd1980-05-14.thru.05-16.fm.kbfh.34685.sbeok.flac16**: source: FM broadcast > cassette (TDK SA-90) [9]
- **gd1980-05-14.125962.naks.wise.minches.flac2496**: taped by Jim Wise; transferred by David Minches; source: Recording by Jim Wise: Master Audience Cassette; 2 Nakamichi 700's with 1 Nakamichi 300 Blend> Nak 550> Sony D-5 at the SBD; Transfer and FLAC encoding by… [2]
